name: Hotpoint HHDW90WWIRE — Heat Pump Tumble Dryer
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Hotpoint HHDW90WWIRE is a 9kg heat pump tumble dryer in white using up to 77% less energy than a B-class condenser. ColdGuard lets it run in temperatures down to 0°C (garages/outbuildings), a PetHairCare steam cycle lifts pet hair, and HomeWhiz gives app control.
features: Up to 77% less energy than B-class condenser
